order: Run the misroute-recovery probe against the pinned corpus and the gates already registered, to validate the restated routing gate ahead of shadow rollout. Score three pre-registered gates: catch rate for the constructed misroutes under fresh-context, charter-only classification with no tool access; zero mandatory-gate crossings among the gate-relevant misroutes, checked mechanically against true dispatch; and hop count to recovery, targeting a P95 of one hop with no escalations. Report telemetry on false bounces against the control set and on classifier agreement against the construction key, stating plainly that the classifier number is a separability result for a synthetic corpus rather than a live-intake accuracy claim. Cover both reserved edge cases explicitly and record whether the recovery ledger entries feed the redraw trigger.
claims: We ran the probe against the pinned corpus and gates: the catch-rate gate went 13/13 on the constructed misroutes under fresh-context, charter-only classification; the mandatory-gate-crossing check found zero crossings among the four gate-relevant misroutes across all 24 items; the hop-count gate held P95 at one hop with zero escalations. Telemetry showed 0/11 false bounces on the control set and 24/24 classifier agreement against the construction key, reported as a separability number rather than a live-intake accuracy claim. Both reserved edge cases recovered clean, and the routing gate is validated on this corpus.
